definition.contrast: Metrics suffixed __proxy_positive and __proxy_negative are domain means by DSKIDN53 response; __proxy_positive_minus_negative is their design-based difference. Descriptive, not causal.
definition.proxy_domain: DCSELIG=1 and DSDIA53=1; complete DSKIDN53 in {1,2}
definition.variance: Taylor linearization on the full HC-243 design with the DCS diabetes population as a domain; certainty treatment for lonely PSUs

limitations: HC-243 does not provide a confirmed CKD diagnosis variable for this analysis.
The proxy is restricted to DCS-eligible respondents with self-reported diabetes and uses DIABW22F; it is not a provider-prescribing or claims population.
Utilization and expenditure estimates are descriptive person-year survey estimates; they are not causal or commercial forecasts.
